name: Transfer funds between shares
description: Transfers an amount between two of a member's shares in MERIDIAN CORE, through the review screen and posting the transaction. Returns the confirmation number and both resulting balances.

inputParams.name: fromShareCode
inputParams.description: Share suffix to transfer from, e.g. S0001.

inputParams.name: toShareCode
inputParams.description: Share suffix to transfer to, e.g. CERT.

outputs.name: fromNewBalance
outputs.description: New balance of source share after transfer

outputs.name: toNewBalance
outputs.description: New balance of destination share after transfer
